title: Grounded World Model: Latent Planning with Language Goals
abstract: arXiv:2604.11751v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: World models such as DINO-WM and LeWM specify the goal with an image, which is difficult to obtain in advance for novel tasks. We present the Grounded World Model (GWM), a latent world model that enables zero-shot planning in the real world from language goals alone. Given a candidate action sequence and the current observation, GWM predicts the future in the visual space of a pretrained video-language embedding model. The frozen readout of this embedding model maps this imagined future and the task description into the same embedding space, where their negative cosine similarity serves as the planning cost. Training GWM requires only offline and task-agnostic video-action pairs and no language labels. In simulated experiments on WISER, planning with GWM, which executes the candidate action of lowest cost, solves 87% of 288 tasks with unseen instructions and visual signals, while ten fine-tuned VLAs average 22%. translated_title: 接地世界模型：基于语言目标的潜在规划
translated_abstract: DINO-WM和LeWM等世界模型使用图像来指定目标，而对于新任务来说，预先获取图像十分困难。我们提出了接地世界模型（GWM），这是一种潜在世界模型，能够仅凭语言目标在现实世界中进行零样本规划。给定候选动作序列和当前观测，GWM在预训练视频-语言嵌入模型的视觉空间中预测未来。该嵌入模型的冻结读出层将想象的未来和任务描述映射到同一嵌入空间中，二者的负余弦相似度即作为规划成本。训练GWM只需要离线的、与任务无关的视频-动作对，且无需语言标签。在WISER的仿真实验中，使用GWM进行规划（执行成本最低的候选动作）在288个具有未见指令和视觉信号的任务中解决了87%，而十个微调的VLA平均仅解决22%。我们随后扩展G（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出接地世界模型（GWM），仅凭语言目标即可实现现实世界的零样本规划，训练时无需语言标签，在288个未见任务中的成功率达87%，远超十个微调VLA平均22%的水平。
en_tdlr: The Grounded World Model (GWM) enables zero-shot real-world planning from language goals alone, trained without language labels, achieving 87% success on 288 unseen tasks versus 22% for fine-tuned VLAs.
